}}}} == Description == This template is used to create a list [[Reward track]]s which contains this item. Format using {{tl|Contained in reward track result format}}. The reward track number i that contains the item is displayed in the following format: * Tier ceil(i/5), (i mod 5) st/nd/rd/th reward. i st/nd/rd/th of total. * For example: ** Tier 1, 1st reward. 01st of total. ** Tier 8, 5th reward. 40th of total. The quantity is stated in the following format: # Reward track available in PvP and WvW: ## Both reward tracks contain the same item: ##* Following the ''standard rules'' of the wiki, i.e. stating the quantity (>1) in parentheses otherwise omitting ''(1)''. ## Only one reward track contains the item: ##* Adding as suffix the game mode after stating the quantity in parentheses, i.e. for clarification ''(1)'' is '''not''' omitted. ## Both reward tracks contain the same item in different quantity (However, this case might not exist yet): ##* Displaying the amount followed by the game mode, again '''not''' omitting ''(1)''. # Reward track only available in PvP or WvW #* Stating the game mode in the reward track header and following the ''standard rules''. == Usage == 
{{Contained in reward track}}
=== Parameters === ;1 ''(unnamed parameter)'' : Required. Item name. Defaults to "PAGENAME". ;indent : Optional. Sets indent, use with bullet list intro. ;limit : Optional. Result limit, defaults to 500 (max). ;offset : Optional. Result offset. ;intro : Optional. Set to "false" to disables intro, used when combining several tables with offset. ;outro : Optional. Set to "false" to disables outro, used when combining several tables with offset. === Example ===
